notes.subject: מתהלך
notes.rationale: 'Mosepele' (yo a sepelago) kgahlanong le 'mokgolelwa/moromuwa' (ASV 'robber') — modumo wa motheo ke go sepela; KJV 'one that travelleth' e bolokwa ka Sepedi.

notes.subject: thebe
notes.rationale: מגן ke thebe ka boeana; 'yo a rweng thebe' e bolokja seswantšho sa Seheberu sa monna yo a hlometšwego.

notes.subject: parallel 6:10–11
notes.rationale: Lentšu le le swanago le boelela go Dieproverbia 6:10–11 — kgwerano ya go utolla le yona ya 'meatla' ×3.

translation: gomme bohloki bja gago bo tla bjalo ka mosepele, gomme tlhokeho ya gago bjalo ka monna yo a rweng thebe.
